learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn to identify Verbs (Action Words) and understand how they show the physical and mental actions we do.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Clap your hands! 👏 Stomp your feet! 👣 Did you know that clapping and stomping are 'doing' words? Let's discover the exciting world of Action Words!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Words that tell us what a person, animal, or thing is DOING are called Verbs (क्रिया). They are Action Words. If you can act it out, it's a verb!
Think about your whole day. Every little thing you do from morning to night is an action word!
Animals do special actions too! Birds fly, frogs hop, and fishes swim. Fly, hop, and swim are all action words.
Some action words don't make any noise and you don't even have to move your legs to do them! Looking, listening, and thinking are also verbs.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of these words is an Action Word (Verb)?
❓ What does a monkey usually do on a tree?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Underline the verb in this sentence: 'The baby cries loudly.'
✍️ Fill in the blank with an action word: 'I ____ milk every morning.'
subjective_practice.hint: What do you do with milk? (Drink / Play)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write one verb that you can do with your eyes.
subjective_practice.hint: You use your eyes to... (See / Watch / Look)

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 Simon Says... Verbs!
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Play 'Simon Says' with your family. Say actions like 'Simon says Jump!', 'Simon says Laugh!', or 'Simon says Freeze!'. Every command is a Verb!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Verbs are Action Words or Doing Words.
⭐ They tell us what someone or something is doing.
⭐ Eating, sleeping, jumping, and thinking are all verbs.
